name: voice-wake
description: Offline macOS wake-word and global hotkey launcher for Google Antigravity: detects custom English phrases or recorded voice samples locally, opens a project chat, triggers built-in dictation, and auto-submits on speech pause, with a bilingual Auxiliary Pane control panel.
suggestedPrompts: Check Voice Wake plugin permissions and microphone status
Set Voice Wake auto-send silence pause to 2.0 seconds
Open the Voice Wake panel to record custom voice samples
